messages:
katie (prod): Customer Z needs auditor-ready artifacts at onboarding (day 0). They specifically asked for a packaged export and proof of integrity. Can we scope an MVP that doesn't block BYOK roadmap?
eric (eng): MVP idea: on-demand export API that bundles auth logs + request headers + invocation traces for a given window. Deliver to customer S3. Avoid streaming for now.
mina (infra): Writing to customer S3 is low risk for us. If they can't provide a bucket, we can stage to redwood-staging but require signed POA and TTL.
dave (security): Must include per-file sha256, manifest.json signed (HMAC or KMS sig), operator id, and keystore fingerprint if envelope-encrypted. Also require export-request audit entry.
sarah (legal): Contract addendum: post-handoff custody shift, customer attestation of secure storage, notification SLA for verification failures, and supported retention tiers (e.g., 30/90/365). I'll draft.
lia (cs): Sales will treat day-0 export as enterprise. Recommend paid add-on; pilot customers can get waived fees. Also need a short SE checklist for customer bucket setup.
derploy-bot: infra/export-pipeline provisioning started by @eric — ETA 1d.
eric (eng): API sketch: POST /v1/tenants/:tid/exports {start_ts,end_ts,target_bucket,notify_email}. Worker writes archive, manifest, and posts audit event with requestor id. Dry-run mode returns estimated bytes.
mina (infra): We'll support gz logs first; consider Parquet if customers want querying. Storage delta >500GB/mo should trigger cost review.
dave (security): Gating checklist for pilot: manifest signing enabled, POA verified, export ACL reviewed, verification job passes. No handoff until checks pass.
sarah (legal): Also require authorized contact for release and proof-of-authority record in export bundle.
eric (eng): Effort estimate: core export + manifest + customer-s3 path = ~3 dev sprints; dry-run estimator + docs + legal addendum = add'l sprint. BYOK handshake deferred.
katie (prod): Decision: Ship MVP = on-demand export to customer S3 + HMAC-signed manifest + dry-run cost estimator. BYOK and hosted staging are stretch. Pilot for 2 customers. Anyone object?
team: +1 from eng/infra/security/legal/cs.
derploy-bot: reminder — create runbook /runbooks/export-handback and incident template /runbooks/export-verify-failure.
katie (prod): Next steps: Eric RFC by Tue, Sarah legal addendum by Wed, Dave security checklist by Fri, Lia collect pilot contacts. Close thread unless objections.
